verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation framework, and one commenter mentions built-in proxies and captcha handling, so a published acceptable-use or anti-abuse policy is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Stagehand or Browserbase publishing such a policy, terms governing stealth use, or any anti-abuse posture. The docs cover only functionality: act, extract, observe, caching, regions and integrations.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can point to the vendor's published acceptable-use and anti-abuse posture governing what its stealth and automation features may be used for
